.NET experts, post your suggestions on how Voat's performance can be inproved here

Dapper, NPOCO, SqlFu, or any other "Micro ORM" will have less overhead than EF and will allow you to write your own queries while still mapping to objects. EF is notorious for generating inefficient SQL queries which is bad once your traffic grows.

That said, there are still a few things they could do to tune EF performance.
I feel like SQL Server is just a bad choice overall for a site like Voat. Wouldn't Mongodb or even Postgresql be a better fit?

MongoDB is a bad choice for pretty much anything if you don't want to lose data.

PostgreSQL would be similar to SQL Server in terms of performance and features, but it could arguably be a better fit for an OSS project.
What about MongoDB for things like votes and PostgresSQL for the data where integrity is important?
Redis probably makes more sense in terms of raw speed in this case.
For which data? You can't store everything in-memory.
Redis has persistence using snapshots, but I was mainly speaking of using Redis as a caching layer and syncing to a RDBMS at a regular interval. That is basically what reddit and stackoverflow do.
Caching would deffinitly help a lot. So yeah, Redis would be a good choice.
